status: declared by the pull request that closes #963 before any score was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing is published, no critical value in force moves, no day after 2025-12-31 and no lockbox day is scored, and nothing here is a verdict (scoring protocol v1, #640). The series are development data seen before this declaration (#949, #922, #886), so a result is exploration only. Whether the confirmation design changes is Eleonora's
hypothesis: H1 step 3 (the confirmation design) and H6 step 1 (event strata); it bears on H5's registration (five-lens review, Lens C, #958)
ruling: Eleonora, 19 October 2026, relayed on #958; the series is the one #949 measured (its walks re-run by scripts/block_length_949.py's recipe)
variants_note: no model and no variant is added: the critical values in force are only read, and the candidates scored are existing ones (B2, spread_mr_ctx of #761, gbm_funding of #634)

series.d: d_t = S(B1) - S(candidate), the lead-averaged grid CRPS of the decision day (scoring_protocol.day_scores), positive favours the candidate: the orientation of #873 and #886

candidates.gbm_funding: scripts/spread_distribution_634.py walks, one per lead, its missing forecasts filled by B1 as the protocol does (#949, #922)

series.b1_prime: B1' (#960) replaces B1 once #960 has merged; it has not, so this declaration runs B1 only and the PR says so
series.days: decision days from 2020-04-03 (the post-2020 history of #886) whose fifth target is on or before 2025-12-31, on the days every candidate has a forecast (their intersection), so the three series are the same days; lockbox.require_unlocked on every decision and target day

calibration.statistic: (mean_w - mean(series)) / se_w, with se_w the window's Newey-West (Bartlett) standard error at lag 10 (scoring_protocol.HAC_LAG), as scoring_protocol.window_t_statistics

generators.contiguous: every start day in [0, n - days], no wrap: the windows the series itself contains, in order
generators.stationary_10: stationary bootstrap, mean block scoring_protocol.BLOCK_LENGTH (10), as #886
generators.circular_10: circular blocks of scoring_protocol.WINDOW_BLOCK (10) days, as scoring_protocol.window_t_statistics

calibration.windows: 20000 per cell for the two random generators, seed 1; the contiguous generator is exhaustive
calibration.critical_value: c = the 0.95 quantile of a generator's window statistics (one-sided level 0.05, whatever the look), so that mean - c * se covers the series' mean on 95% of that generator's windows; it is not the nominal level of scoring_protocol.nominal_levels
calibration.size: the share of a generator's window statistics above the critical value in force (scoring_protocol.CRITICAL_VALUES, grid comparison: 125 days 3.419438620805254, 250 days 2.425730476113518; 500 days has none in force and is read at the 250-day value)
calibration.effective_windows: n / days, the number of non-overlapping windows of that length the series holds (a count of independent windows at most, as the windows of a persistent series overlap in information)

reading_rules.survives: the contiguous-window c at 250 days on the candidate's own d is below 3.0: the 250-day design survives
reading_rules.fails: that c is above 4: no 250-day pooled test can confirm anything short of a 20-30% skill
reading_rules.between: between 3.0 and 4.0 neither rule applies and the page says so

event_strata.metric: the H5 metric: grid CRPS, restricted to targets on declared risk dates; a target day's score is the mean over leads 1-5 of the cells that target, and d is S(benchmark) - S(candidate) on those target days

strata.month_end: SplitDeclaration.reporting_day_type(target) == 'month_end' (one of the month's last two business days, which holds the turn of the month); #959's turn label has not merged, so the current one is used and the page says so
strata.coupon_settlement: the target row has treasury_settlement_coupons > 0 (may overlap the others)

event_strata.pairing: each candidate against B1 and against B2 (B2 as a candidate against B1 only), scoring_protocol.paired_tests on the target days of the stratum: stationary bootstrap, mean block 3 events, HAC lag 3, seed 1, 10000 draws
event_strata.between_event_acf: the sample autocorrelation of d at lags 1-3 across consecutive events of the stratum, in date order

fixed_b.statistic: the mean of d over a 2-year window of 500 decision days, divided by its Bartlett long-run standard error with bandwidth M = b * T, b = 0.1, T = 500 (M = 50, lag 49)
fixed_b.critical_value: the 0.95 quantile of that statistic on 20000 iid N(0,1) series of 500 days, seed 1 (the fixed-b limit does not depend on the series' dependence)
fixed_b.report: for each candidate: the statistic on the last 500 days of the series, beside the NW(10) statistic and the normal 1.645, and the share of contiguous 500-day windows of the series, centred at its mean, above each critical value (their size)

limits: no published record, declaration or critical value changes; the protocol's constants are only read
